name: stale-hint-done-prepare-drift-class
title: Enrich the stale-evidence hint with done_prepare recovery + drift classification
description: renderEvidenceStaleHint (the single cross-surface stale verificationEvidence hint, used byte-identically by session_brief / story_advance pre-check / validate) currently offers only verification_evidence_refresh_stale + validate. It does not point the Host to done_prepare (the one-step ordered recovery) and does not classify the drift (whole-tree materialHash-only vs story-owned storyFilesHash), so a Host cannot tell a cheap refresh from a real re-review. Enrich the shared renderer; the three surfaces auto-inherit. Validated via red/spike (RED test exit 1; scratch green proof).
